assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent sprite atlas for an existing 2D arcade game. Edit target is the supplied 3x3 character atlas: replace the costume and props as described, preserve recognizable face, species and main body colors, same polished outlined 32-bit cartoon pixel-art rendering. Costume, anatomy, fingers and props integrated into ONE complete drawing in EACH pose, never floating or pasted-on parts. Exactly NINE full-body figures, in a uniform 3-COLUMN 3-ROW grid, transparent background, no text, names, borders or ground shadows. All facing RIGHT 3/4 view. First TWO rows are SIX distinct sequential walk poses with opposite feet and arms alternating. Third row: windup, attack action, defeated seated with X eyes. Equal character scale and ground baseline across cells. Leave generous transparent padding between all characters and canvas edges; tools, hose, ears, antennae and tails must be COMPLETE, inside their own cell, not touching another figure. No detached particles or magic effects baked in. Blue penguin Pablo is a lunar astronaut: white padded spacesuit with blue panels and orange seams, clear round helmet showing his full blue face and yellow beak, small oxygen backpack, connected gloves and space boots. Carry a compact sci-fi pulse emitter integrated with the right glove. Walk on feet rather than flying. Windup crouching and aiming emitter in front; attack a short upward lunar hop with emitter aimed forward right and feet tucked, no beam drawn. Defeat seated with visor open, X eyes and emitter lowered. Remove engineer vest, shovel and construction hard hat completely.
